repairs.quote: Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains 135/145/155/165/175 range, deals an additional (20/45/70/95/120 + (50% bonus Attack Damage)) physical damage, and removes 10/15/20/25/30% Armor for 3 seconds. This Ability's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
